create_WallEntity: create a WallEntity instance with parameters defining two 3D corners, height, and thickness
compute_WallEntity_extent: compute the bounding box extent of a WallEntity including min/max/size for x, y, z axes
rotate_WallEntity: rotate a WallEntity around the Z-axis by a given angle in degrees
translate_WallEntity: translate a WallEntity by a 3D vector in x, y, z directions
lex_sort_WallEntity: lexicographically sort the corners of a WallEntity and return a sorted key array
